Noah: quick hit from a customer onboarding run — sampleapp behaved differently across sdks when both REDWOOD_API_KEY and REDWOOD_ORG_KEY were set. brief log and suggested fix.

Noah: repro: set both envs and run node samples/quickstart.js and python samples/quickstart.py in separate containers. Node logged: "Using API key: REDWOOD_ORG_KEY", Python logged: "Using API key: REDWOOD_API_KEY".

Elena: that matches a parity gap we saw. js env normalizer historically preferred legacy vars in some transitive versions. do we have a canonical precedence documented anywhere?

Ravi: not consistently. proposal: canonicalize to REDWOOD_API_KEY (single env) and treat REDWOOD_PROJECT_KEY and REDWOOD_ORG_KEY as legacy fallbacks. precedence: REDWOOD_API_KEY > REDWOOD_PROJECT_KEY > REDWOOD_ORG_KEY. If multiple present, prefer the highest-precedence and emit a single WARN.

Priya: agree. implement plan: (1) add a one-line deprecation WARN during SDK init if legacy vars used, (2) add a parity test in sdk-ci that runs small program in each language with env combos, (3) update all sampleapps to show REDWOOD_API_KEY only and include a tiny troubleshooting snippet.

Noah: customer wants rotation to 'just work' for long-running containers. we currently read env at init and cache client. customers expect rotating key in dashboard to take effect. can we add a refresh helper?

Ravi: yes - add Client.reload_from_env() pattern across sdks. short-term docs will show a SIGHUP handler or an HTTP endpoint that calls reload. Medium-term we can add a CLI helper to signal processes.

Elena: small UX detail: when warning about legacy vars, include redacted snippet of which envs were found (e.g., REDWOOD_ORG_KEY=org_***). that helps support without leaking tokens.

Priya: telemetry: optional opt-in event when WARN fires so infra can measure how many customers hit ambiguous configs. default off.

Noah: timeline? I need a docs patch before next Monday onboarding session.

Ravi: I'll PR the js fix and parity-test scaffolding today, Priya take py, Elena take sampleapps docs. We can land warnings in a minor release and announce migration in quickstart README.

deploy-bot: CI queued for branch auth-env-unify (#27), build 9124.

Noah: thanks team. I'll update support with the workaround (unset legacy envs) and the short-term rotation guidance. Ping #devex when PRs are ready so we can update internal onboarding notes.
